summary: Weyco Group filed a Form 8-K on September 24, 2026, reporting entry into a Sixth Amendment to its November 4, 2020 revolving credit agreement with Associated Bank, National Association. The amendment solely extends the facility maturity to September 23, 2027; no other terms changed. The revolver carries a $40.0 million maximum borrowing limit, bears interest at one-month term SOFR plus 110 basis points, is secured by a security interest in general business assets, and includes customary covenants such as a minimum tangible net worth test. This is a routine credit-facility amendment, not a special situation; no deal terms or risk-arb angle apply.
